app/src/server/functions.ts:1-38 — all createServerFn handlers in one module; components never import server/pokeapi.ts directly

coupling.rationale: Loose coupling with clear seams: one server data layer, one server-fn boundary, narrow shared types. Only minor tangles — the home route's state dance and API-media knowledge leaking into lib/format.ts.

abstraction_design.rationale: The abstractions stretch to the real variation in the app (card extras, level-up columns, relation tables) without boolean creep; an Items section would copy ~30 lines of route boilerplate rather than reuse a generic resource abstraction, which is the right trade for four resource types.

findings.issue: Card data has two independent producers: toCards (line 96) for the move/ability/type lists and speciesIndex (line 172) for home; both feed PokemonCardList but must be changed in tandem for any per-card data change (e.g. real sprite URLs instead of ID-constructed ones).
findings.suggestion: Shape home's entries through the same card helper (or extract a shared card-shaping function) so card fields have one home.

findings.issue: spriteUrl constructs media URLs from the species ID rather than the API's sprites.front_default, encoding an API-media layout assumption in a generic formatting module.
findings.suggestion: Name the helper for what it assumes (default-front-sprite-by-id) and keep it beside the mediaBase seam, or thread the API-provided URL through CardData if the ID assumption ever breaks.

findings.issue: The home route synchronizes a debounced input, a lastPushed ref and URL search params, and derives the page from a query-equality check (line 76); filter-behaviour changes require reasoning about three overlapping states.
findings.suggestion: Keep only the raw input debounced and derive the effective filter/page purely from validated search state.

findings.issue: The ability-only 'Hidden ability' rendering (and CardData.hidden at lib/types.ts:10) lives in the shared card component, so removing Abilities leaves dead code in a component used by every page.
findings.suggestion: Render feature-specific notes via a slot/child prop, or accept that feature removal should prune this flag along with the route.

findings.issue: Cache policy is split across layers: server-side TTL/memo here versus per-route staleTime/shouldReload (routes/__root.tsx:10-11, routes/index.tsx:31).
findings.suggestion: Centralize route-level cache settings in the router (router.tsx defaultPreloadStaleTime/defaultStaleTime) so a policy change touches one file.

findings.issue: The `?? 'Not found'` title fallback is duplicated across four route heads plus the root's matches-based check (routes/__root.tsx:13-18); changing the not-found title touches five files.
findings.suggestion: Drop the per-route fallback and rely on the root head's notFound detection, or extract a shared head helper.

summary: A well-factored app on the current stable TanStack Start idiom (createServerFn + validator, file-based routes, a single memoized server data layer) with narrow view-model types and one render path per concept. The main editability risks are the duplicated card-data producers and the home route's multi-source filter state, both contained but non-obvious. Extending with another resource follows an established, copyable pattern rather than needing new abstractions.

scenarios.change: Remove the Abilities pages and every link to them
scenarios.notes: Deleting the route file and the one Section block (pokemon.$name.tsx:110-121) removes the feature; the route tree regenerates. Only the two server-side helpers and the hidden flag on the shared card need pruning to avoid dead code.

spriteUrl (format.ts:23) plus PokemonCard.tsx:16 is the single render path, so one fix covers every list. But the URL is ID-derived rather than taken from the API, so a data-driven fix must add a CardData field and touch both producers (toCards at pokeapi.ts:96 and speciesIndex at pokeapi.ts:172).

scenarios.change: Add sorting by name to every list of Pokémon cards

Doing it at the data layer means two edits (toCards' sort at pokeapi.ts:99 and home's client-side pipeline in routes/index.tsx), and home's spec-mandated dex order interacts with any default change.
